releases.summary: Merged since 0.15.0, coming in the next release.

changes.title: Documentation on the website
changes.description: A `/docs` section with a sidebar: commands, options, the configuration file, check rules, README format, specs and decisions, and guides for the dashboard, CI, the MCP server, external data and aggregation.

changes.title: Every option in features.config.yaml
changes.description: Any command line option can be set in `features.config.yaml`: shared options at the top level, options of one command in a section named after it (`serve: { port: 4000 }`, `diff: { since: origin/main }`). The command line wins over the file. `--config <file>` reads another file and `--no-config` ignores it. `features.config.toml` is no longer read: move its `name` to the YAML file.

changes.title: Configurable check rules
changes.description: `features check` runs rules with a severity (`error`, `warn` or `off`): duplicate names and keys, record issues, missing owners and stale feature flags by default, plus opt-in `missing-readme`, `min-coverage` and `cross-feature-import`. Set them in `check.rules` of `features.config.yaml` or with `--rule`, `--enable-rule` and `--disable-rule`. `--format github` prints GitHub Actions annotations, `--list-rules` shows the effective severities.

changes.title: Install with a shell script
changes.description: `curl -fsSL <website>/install.sh | sh` downloads the prebuilt binary for macOS or Linux from the GitHub release, verifies its checksum and installs it in `~/.local/bin`. The command is in the install picker of the CLI page.

changes.title: Owner pages
changes.description: An experimental page per owner (team or person) gathers their features, totals, `--data` metrics, recent changes, specs and decisions. Enable it with `--experimental`.

changes.title: Risk matrix and feature health score
changes.description: A Risk matrix tab in Insights plots each feature's untested lines or TODO density against its activity, and a sortable Health column scores every feature.

changes.title: `features mcp`, an MCP server
changes.description: AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Cursor can query the feature map over stdio: list features, get a feature, find an owner, list touched features and records.

releases.summary: Specs and decisions, feature history, feature keys and links, multi-repository reports and a new app menu.

changes.title: Outside features page
changes.description: Project-level records and features that could not be merged across repositories now live on one Outside features page.

changes.title: Feature graph in History
changes.description: A Graph tab on the History page draws each feature as a git-like lane from the commit that created it, so you can see when features and sub-features appeared.

changes.title: Feature history from commits
changes.description: A History page built from the commit history shows when each feature changed and who changed it.

changes.title: Feature keys, links and external data
changes.description: Every feature gets a stable key, links to tools like PostHog or Sentry, and `--data` merges external metrics by feature key into the dashboard.

changes.title: Specs and decisions side by side
changes.description: Each feature shows its specs and decision records next to each other, read from `__docs__` folders, `docs/specs` and `docs/decisions`.

changes.title: Linear-style app menu and project name in the sidebar
changes.description: A new app menu with docs, feedback, theme and a What's new timeline, and the project name at the top of the sidebar.

changes.title: Spec Kit and Kiro specs
changes.description: Specs written with GitHub Spec Kit (`specs/NNN-name/`) or Kiro (`.kiro/specs/`) are read and attached to their feature.

changes.title: Aggregate reports from several repositories
changes.description: `features aggregate` merges the reports of several repositories into one feature tree and one dashboard.

changes.title: `--since` diff mode
changes.description: `--since <ref>` lists the features and owners touched since a branch or commit, handy in pull-request reviews.

changes.title: Security hardening and `--strip-emails`
changes.description: The local server no longer sends open CORS headers and rejects unknown Host headers, credentials are stripped from remote URLs, and `--strip-emails` removes author emails from reports.
